title: 3-tool stack combines Obsidian, Claw Code, and AI for smart solo #AItools #Productivity #Obsidian
description: This concept introduces a three-tool system designed to enable a single person to run a company efficiently: Obsidian, Claw Code, and an AI agent that operates autonomously. The core insight is that the AI agent’s effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of its underlying memory, organized as a connected knowledge base or wiki. The process starts with building a comprehensive, well-structured wiki using Claw Code, which ingests raw sources, summarizes, links, and files information automatically to create an interconnected graph in Obsidian. This evolving knowledge base sharpens the AI’s outputs over time by compounding insights from multiple sources. The AI agent, named Hermes, then leverages this enriched knowledge graph to perform recurring tasks autonomously, gradually improving its capabilities. This approach stands out because it emphasizes foundational knowledge management before deploying AI automation, avoiding the common mistake of prioritizing flashy agent features without solid information architecture. The system scales well by continuously updating and refining the repository, making repetitive work sustainable and more efficient for solo entrepreneurs or small teams. #Obsidian #AIautomation #KnowledgeManagement #LLMWiki #ClawCode #HermesAgent #SoloFounder #AITools #ConnectedGraph #TaskAutomation #AIProductivity #WorkflowOptimization #AutonomousAgent #AIknowledgebase #PersonalAI #BusinessTechnology
